title.en: Air-con & refrigeration technician: from listing to the customers who can find you
title.af: Lugversorging- en verkoelingstegnikus: van advertensie tot die kliënte wat jou kan vind
title.zu: Uchwepheshe wama-aircon nezifriji: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kumakhasimende angakuthola
title.xh: Ingcali yee-aircon neefriji: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kubathengi abanokukufumana
title.nso: Setsebi sa di-aircon le difriji: go tloga papatšong go ya go bareki bao ba ka go hwetšago

gate_note.en: Coming up at step 11: until our team has checked your licence, only people you send your link to can see your listing.
gate_note.af: By stap 11: totdat ons span jou lisensie nagegaan het, kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur jou advertensie sien.
gate_note.zu: Kuyeza esinyathelweni 11: kuze kube yilapho ithimba lethu selihlolile ilayisensi yakho, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangabona isikhangiso sakho.
gate_note.xh: Kwinyathelo le-11: de iqela lethu lihlole ilayisenisi yakho, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokubona intengiso yakho.
gate_note.nso: Kgatong ya 11: go fihlela sehlopha sa rena se hlahlobile laesense ya gago, ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka bonago papatšo ya gago.

chapters.nso: Bareki ba gago ba ka mehla

en: Open Quick, tap [[Offer a service]]
Quick opens on the services door. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, tik [[Offer a service]]
Quick maak oop by die dienste-deur. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, thepha [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula emnyango wezinsizakalo. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, cofa [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula kucango leenkonzo. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, kgotla [[Offer a service]]
Quick e bula lebating la ditirelo. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Installers & repairs]], then [[Air-con & refrigeration technician]]
Choose the kind of work, then your trade. The law asks for a licence for this work, so Quick tells you what our team checks.
af: Kies [[Installers & repairs]], dan [[Air-con & refrigeration technician]]
Kies die soort werk, dan jou ambag. Die wet vra 'n lisensie vir hierdie werk, so Quick sê vir jou wat ons span nagaan.

en: Say what qualification you have
[[Trade-tested]], [[Certificate]] or [[Experience only]]. Customers see it on your listing.
af: Sê watter kwalifikasie jy het
[[Trade-tested]], [[Certificate]] of [[Experience only]]. Kliënte sien dit op jou advertensie.
zu: Sho ukuthi unayiphi imfundo
[[Trade-tested]], [[Certificate]] noma [[Experience only]]. Amakhasimende ayibona esikhangisweni sakho.
xh: Yitsho ukuba unasiphi isiqinisekiso
[[Trade-tested]], [[Certificate]] okanye [[Experience only]]. Abathengi bayayibona kwintengiso yakho.
nso: Bolela gore o na le thuto efe
[[Trade-tested]], [[Certificate]] goba [[Experience only]]. Bareki ba e bona papatšong ya gago.

en: Tick every area you work in
You can tick more than one, and a customer searching any of them finds you. Type your area if it is not listed.
af: Merk elke area waar jy werk
Jy kan meer as een merk, en 'n kliënt wat in enige van hulle soek, vind jou. Tik jou area in as dit nie gelys is nie.
zu: Maka zonke izindawo osebenza kuzo
Ungamaka ezingaphezu kweyodwa, futhi ikhasimende elisesha kunoma iyiphi yazo liyakuthola. Bhala indawo yakho uma ingekho ohlwini.
xh: Phawula yonke imimandla osebenza kuyo
Ungaphawula engaphezu komnye, kwaye umthengi okhangela kuyo nayiphi na uyakufumana. Bhala indawo yakho ukuba ayikho kuluhlu.
nso: Swaya mafelo ka moka ao o šomago go ona
O ka swaya a fetago le tee, gomme moreki yo a nyakago go le ge e le lefe la ona o a go hwetša. Ngwala lefelo la gago ge le se lenaneong.

en: Set your call-out fee and your hourly rate
Tap [[Call-out + per hour]], type your call-out fee, then your rate per hour. Tap [[Plus parts and materials]] if the customer pays for parts.
af: Stel jou uitroepfooi en jou uurtarief
Tik [[Call-out + per hour]], tik jou uitroepfooi in, dan jou tarief per uur. Tik [[Plus parts and materials]] as die kliënt vir onderdele betaal.
zu: Beka imali yokubizwa kanye nemali yehora
Thepha [[Call-out + per hour]], bhala imali yokubizwa, bese kuba imali yakho ngehora. Thepha [[Plus parts and materials]] uma ikhasimende likhokhela izingxenye.
xh: Misela intlawulo yokubizwa kunye nexabiso leyure
Cofa [[Call-out + per hour]], bhala intlawulo yokubizwa, emva koko ixabiso lakho ngeyure. Cofa [[Plus parts and materials]] ukuba umthengi uhlawulela iindawo.
nso: Bea tefo ya go bitšwa le tefo ya iri
Kgotla [[Call-out + per hour]], ngwala tefo ya go bitšwa, ke moka tefo ya gago ka iri. Kgotla [[Plus parts and materials]] ge moreki a lefela ditlabelo.

en: Note the licence line, then save
Above [[Save my listing]] Quick tells you: your listing shows in searches once your licence is verified. Tick your languages and save.
af: Let op die lisensie-reël en stoor dan
Bo [[Save my listing]] sê Quick vir jou: jou advertensie verskyn in soektogte sodra jou lisensie geverifieer is. Merk jou tale en stoor.
zu: Qaphela umugqa welayisensi, bese ulondoloza
Ngaphezu kwe-[[Save my listing]] i-Quick ikutshela: isikhangiso sakho sivela ekuseshweni uma ilayisensi yakho isiqinisekisiwe. Maka izilimi zakho bese ulondoloza.
xh: Qaphela umgca welayisenisi, uze ugcine
Ngaphezu kwe-[[Save my listing]] i-Quick ikuxelela: intengiso yakho ivela ekukhangeleni xa ilayisenisi yakho iqinisekisiwe. Phawula iilwimi zakho uze ugcine.
nso: Ela hloko mothalo wa laesense, ke moka o boloke
Godimo ga [[Save my listing]] Quick e go botša: papatšo ya gago e tšwelela dinyakišišong ge laesense ya gago e netefaditšwe. Swaya maleme a gago gomme o boloke.

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]], or open the email we sent you. Nobody can see your listing yet.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die bepalings en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]], of maak die e-pos oop wat ons gestuur het. Niemand kan jou advertensie nog sien nie.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]], noma uvule i-imeyili esikuthumelele yona. Akekho umuntu ongabona isikhangiso sakho okwamanje.
xh: Kugciniwe: ngoku sayina imimiselo uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]], okanye uvule i-imeyile esikuthumelele yona. Akukho mntu unokubona intengiso yakho okwangoku.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena melawana gomme o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]], goba o bule imeile ye re go rometšego yona. Ga go yo a ka bonago papatšo ya gago ga bjale.

en: Add your photo and photos of your work
In TrustSquare tap [[Edit]], then [[Add Photo]]. Add your tools and jobs you have finished, like a DB board you wired. No faces, signs or phone numbers.
af: Voeg jou foto en foto's van jou werk by
Tik in TrustSquare [[Edit]], dan [[Add Photo]]. Voeg jou gereedskap by en werk wat jy klaar gemaak het, soos 'n verdeelbord wat jy bedraad het. Geen gesigte, borde of telefoonnommers nie.
zu: Engeza isithombe sakho nezithombe zomsebenzi wakho
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Edit]], bese [[Add Photo]]. Engeza amathuluzi akho nemisebenzi oyiqedile, njenge-DB board oyixhumile. Akukho buso, izimpawu noma izinombolo zocingo.
xh: Yongeza ifoto yakho neefoto zomsebenzi wakho
Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Edit]], emva koko [[Add Photo]]. Yongeza izixhobo zakho nemisebenzi oyigqibileyo, njenge-DB board oyifakileyo. Akukho buso, miqondiso okanye iinombolo zefowuni.
nso: Tsenya seswantšho sa gago le diswantšho tša mošomo wa gago
Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Edit]], ke moka [[Add Photo]]. Tsenya didirišwa tša gago le mešomo yeo o e feditšego, bjalo ka DB board yeo o e tsentšego. Ga go difahlego, maswao goba dinomoro tša mogala.

en: Accept the seller terms once
Read them, tick both boxes at the end and tap [[I accept]].
af: Aanvaar die verkopersbepalings een keer
Lees hulle, merk albei blokkies aan die einde en tik [[I accept]].
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, maka omabili amabhokisi ekugcineni bese uthepha [[I accept]].
xh: Yamkela imimiselo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, phawula zombini iibhokisi ekugqibeleni uze ucofe [[I accept]].
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
E bale, swaya mapokisi a mabedi mafelelong gomme o kgotle [[I accept]].

en: Publish: only people you send your link to see it yet
Tap [[Publish]]. Your card says the law needs a licence for this work, and customers see your listing once our team has checked yours.
af: Publiseer: net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur, sien dit nog
Tik [[Publish]]. Jou kaart sê die wet vra 'n lisensie vir hierdie werk, en kliënte sien jou advertensie sodra ons span joune nagegaan het.
zu: Shicilela: ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abasibonayo okwamanje
Thepha [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho lithi umthetho ufuna ilayisensi yalo msebenzi, futhi amakhasimende abona isikhangiso sakho uma ithimba lethu selihlolile eyakho.
xh: Papasha: ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abayibonayo okwangoku
Cofa [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho lithi umthetho ufuna ilayisenisi yalo msebenzi, kwaye abathengi babona intengiso yakho xa iqela lethu lihlole eyakho.
nso: Phatlalatša: ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba e bonago ga bjale
Kgotla [[Publish]]. Karata ya gago e re molao o nyaka laesense ya mošomo wo, gomme bareki ba bona papatšo ya gago ge sehlopha sa rena se hlahlobile ya gago.

en: Tap [[Upload my licence]]
Edit opens with [[Licence to practise]] chosen. Choose a photo of your DoEL registration (or your SAQCC, PSIRA or PrDP card).
af: Tik [[Upload my licence]]
Edit maak oop met [[Licence to practise]] gekies. Kies 'n foto van jou DoEL-registrasie (of jou SAQCC-, PSIRA- of PrDP-kaart).
zu: Thepha [[Upload my licence]]
I-Edit ivuleka kukhethwe [[Licence to practise]]. Khetha isithombe sokubhaliswa kwakho kwe-DoEL (noma ikhadi lakho le-SAQCC, PSIRA noma PrDP).
xh: Cofa [[Upload my licence]]
I-Edit ivuleka kukhethwe [[Licence to practise]]. Khetha ifoto yobhaliso lwakho lwe-DoEL (okanye ikhadi lakho le-SAQCC, PSIRA okanye PrDP).
nso: Kgotla [[Upload my licence]]
Edit e bulega go kgethilwe [[Licence to practise]]. Kgetha seswantšho sa ngwadišo ya gago ya DoEL (goba karata ya gago ya SAQCC, PSIRA goba PrDP).

en: It goes to our team
Tap [[Upload Document]]. A person checks it. Nothing is added to your score, and strangers do not see you, before then.
af: Dit gaan na ons span
Tik [[Upload Document]]. 'n Mens gaan dit na. Niks word by jou telling gevoeg nie, en vreemdelinge sien jou nie, voor dan.
zu: Iya ethimbeni lethu
Thepha [[Upload Document]]. Umuntu uyayihlola. Akukho okwengezwa emaphuzwini akho, futhi abantu ongabazi abakuboni, ngaphambi kwalokho.
xh: Iya kwiqela lethu
Cofa [[Upload Document]]. Umntu uyayihlola. Akukho nto yongezwa kumanqaku akho, kwaye abantu ongabaziyo abakuboni, ngaphambi koko.
nso: E ya go sehlopha sa rena
Kgotla [[Upload Document]]. Motho o a e hlahloba. Ga go selo se se okeletšwago dintlheng tša gago, gomme batho bao o sa ba tsebego ga ba go bone, pele ga moo.

en: Your card shows it is waiting
[[Seller Hub]] says your licence is with our team. Your regulars can still reach you through your link.
af: Jou kaart wys dit wag
[[Seller Hub]] sê jou lisensie is by ons span. Jou vaste kliënte kan jou steeds deur jou skakel bereik.
zu: Ikhadi lakho likhombisa ukuthi kulindwe
I-[[Seller Hub]] ithi ilayisensi yakho isethimbeni lethu. Amakhasimende akho ajwayelekile asengakufinyelela ngesixhumanisi sakho.
xh: Ikhadi lakho libonisa ukuba kulindiwe
I-[[Seller Hub]] ithi ilayisenisi yakho ikwiqela lethu. Abathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo basenokukufikelela ngekhonkco lakho.
nso: Karata ya gago e bontšha gore go a letelwa
[[Seller Hub]] e re laesense ya gago e go sehlopha sa rena. Bareki ba gago ba ka mehla ba sa kgona go go fihlelela ka kgokagano ya gago.

en: Our team checks it: customers can find you
Once a person has checked your licence, your listing shows in searches and customers see the licence on your profile.
af: Ons span gaan dit na: kliënte kan jou vind
Sodra 'n mens jou lisensie nagegaan het, verskyn jou advertensie in soektogte en sien kliënte die lisensie op jou profiel.
zu: Ithimba lethu liyayihlola: amakhasimende angakuthola
Uma umuntu eseyihlolile ilayisensi yakho, isikhangiso sakho sivela ekuseshweni futhi amakhasimende ayibona ilayisensi kuphrofayela yakho.
xh: Iqela lethu liyayihlola: abathengi banokukufumana
Xa umntu eyihlolile ilayisenisi yakho, intengiso yakho ivela ekukhangeleni kwaye abathengi bayibona ilayisenisi kwiprofayile yakho.
nso: Sehlopha sa rena se a e hlahloba: bareki ba ka go hwetša
Ge motho a hlahlobile laesense ya gago, papatšo ya gago e tšwelela dinyakišišong gomme bareki ba bona laesense profaeleng ya gago.

en: Send your Buzz link to your regular customers
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]] and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all of them: [[Send on WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan jou vaste kliënte
Maak in [[My Space]] [[Buzz]] oop en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir almal: [[Send on WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].
zu: Thumela isixhumanisi sakho se-Buzz kumakhasimende akho ajwayelekile
Ku-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] bese uthepha [[Get my link]]. Isixhumanisi esisodwa sabo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] noma [[Copy]].
xh: Thumela ikhonkco lakho le-Buzz kubathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo
Kwi-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] uze ucofe [[Get my link]]. Ikhonkco elinye labo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] okanye [[Copy]].
nso: Romela kgokagano ya gago ya Buzz go bareki ba gago ba ka mehla
Go [[My Space]], bula [[Buzz]] gomme o kgotle [[Get my link]]. Kgokagano e tee ya bohle: [[Send on WhatsApp]] goba [[Copy]].

en: A regular customer joins
She opens your link, ticks the Buzz terms and taps [[Continue]]. Now you can buzz each other.
af: 'n Vaste kliënt sluit aan
Sy maak jou skakel oop, merk die Buzz-bepalings en tik [[Continue]]. Nou kan julle mekaar buzz.
zu: Ikhasimende elijwayelekile liyajoyina
Uvula isixhumanisi sakho, amake imigomo ye-Buzz bese ethepha [[Continue]]. Manje ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
xh: Umthengi oqhelekileyo uyajoyina
Uvula ikhonkco lakho, aphawule imimiselo ye-Buzz aze acofe [[Continue]]. Ngoku ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
nso: Moreki wa ka mehla o a tsena
O bula kgokagano ya gago, a swaye melawana ya Buzz gomme a kgotle [[Continue]]. Bjale le ka romelana ka Buzz.

en: She buzzes you a job
One line, straight to your phone: "The DB board trips when the geyser comes on. Can you come Thursday?" If your phone has no push, it comes by email.
af: Sy buzz vir jou 'n werk
Een reël, reguit na jou foon: "Die verdeelbord klink uit as die geiser aanskakel. Kan jy Donderdag kom?" As jou foon nie kennisgewings kry nie, kom dit per e-pos.
zu: Ukuthumelela umsebenzi nge-Buzz
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde ocingweni lwakho: "I-DB board iyacima uma i-geyser ivuleka. Ungafika ngoLwesine?" Uma ucingo lwakho lungenazo izaziso, kufika nge-imeyili.
xh: Ukuthumelela umsebenzi nge-Buzz
Umgca omnye, ngqo kwifowuni yakho: "I-DB board iyacima xa i-geyser ivuleka. Ungeza ngoLwesine?" Ukuba ifowuni yakho ayinazo izaziso, iza nge-imeyile.
nso: O go romela mošomo ka Buzz
Mothalo o tee, thwii mogaleng wa gago: "DB board e a tima ge geyser e bulega. O ka tla ka Labone?" Ge mogala wa gago o se na ditsebišo, e tla ka imeile.

en: A new customer finds you and sees your licence
She finds you by trade and area. On your profile she sees your checked licence before she asks.
af: 'n Nuwe kliënt vind jou en sien jou lisensie
Sy vind jou volgens ambag en area. Op jou profiel sien sy jou nagegane lisensie voordat sy vra.
zu: Ikhasimende elisha likuthola futhi libona ilayisensi yakho
Ukuthola ngobuciko nendawo. Kuphrofayela yakho ubona ilayisensi yakho ehloliwe ngaphambi kokuba acele.
xh: Umthengi omtsha ukufumana kwaye abone ilayisenisi yakho
Ukufumana ngobugcisa nommandla. Kwiprofayile yakho ubona ilayisenisi yakho ehloliweyo phambi kokuba acele.
nso: Moreki yo moswa o go hwetša gomme a bona laesense ya gago
O go hwetša ka bokgoni le lefelo. Profaeleng ya gago o bona laesense ya gago ye e hlahlobilwego pele a kgopela.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message and taps [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept. Asking twice holds nothing more.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap en tik [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence word van haar gehou, en net gebruik as jy aanvaar. As sy twee keer vra, word niks meer gehou nie.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane bese ethepha [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela. Ukucela kabili akubambi lutho olunye.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane aze acofe [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela. Ukucela kabini akubambi nto yimbi.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana gomme a kgotla [[Join queue]]. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela. Go kgopela gabedi ga go swere selo se sengwe.

en: You accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Jy aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord daarop om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Uyamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: phendula kuyo ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Uyamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: phendula kuyo ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: O a amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Le hwetša imeile ka bobedi: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who works like you.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriend wat werk soos jy.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane osebenza njengawe.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo osebenza njengawe.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] gomme o e abelane le mogwera yo a šomago bjalo ka wena.
